Edge cases were chosen from real inputs: empty strings, whitespace-only values, mixed scripts, and values that already look normalised. The worker reported its result as a digest; I read the files themselves before accepting it, because digests summarise intent, not behaviour.
```ts
export function slugify(input: string, options: { strict?: boolean } = {}): string {
  const value = input.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  if (options.strict && value.trim() === '') throw new Error('slugify: empty input');
  return value
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
}
```
